# Preface {-}

This is a _user manual_ written using Bookdown, which provides a detailed guide for **ArthOMix Explorer**.

ArthOMix Explorer is an R Shiny application for interactive, no-code analysis of transcriptomic and methylomic data, built around a sex-stratified analysis workflow (dataset loading → preprocessing → differential analysis → network/feature analysis → biomarker modeling → genetics/interpretation). The application handles gene expression (RNA-seq/microarray) and DNA methylation (Illumina array) data through a shared set of interaction patterns, so once a user has learned one module the rest follow the same conventions.

[One short paragraph: who this guide is for (e.g. wet-lab collaborators without a coding background), and what "no-code" means in this app — every analysis is driven by point-and-click controls, never a script the user has to edit.]

## How to use this guide {-}

Each chapter covers one module of the app and follows the same structure: **Purpose** (what question it answers), **Getting there** (where to click), **Inputs**, a **Walkthrough** of every sub-tab with an annotated screenshot, **Outputs**, and **Notes and troubleshooting**.
